title: Value of the refresh_token member in a Zoom token response
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member in a Zoom user-authorization token response, shown as a pretty-printed JSON body, a compact JSON body behind raw HTTP response headers and the output of a curl request.
rationale: Zoom documents that a user-authorization or device flow returns a refresh_token that lives 90 days and whose latest value is used for the next refresh. Zoom states no prefix, alphabet or length, and the documentation placeholder does not establish a JWT structure, so the value is flagged because of the member it sits in, not because of its shape. The extent is the member value only.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the refresh_token member of the token response is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Zoom documents that the token response returns a refresh_token member (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: Refresh tokens expire after 90 days. You should always use the latest refresh token for the next refresh request.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
